title: ₹36,000, Said a Free AI. ₹44,000, the Real Cost. (Creative 32)

t.ask: I may have to move out after 4 months for a job transfer. What will it cost me?
t.reply: So, if you need to move out after 4 months for a job transfer, you will have to pay Rs 36,000 as a penalty according to the agreement.
t.lit: you will have to pay Rs 36,000
t.c10: 10. Lock-in: ... If the Tenant vacates during the lock-in period, the Tenant shall pay two months' rent, Rs 36,000, as a penalty, which the Owner may deduct from the security deposit.
t.c11: 11. Painting: when the Tenant vacates, Rs 8,000 towards repainting shall be deducted from the security deposit.
t.better: List every amount of money I may have to pay or lose, and every condition on leaving early. Give the clause number for each.
t.found: Cost towards Repainting when Vacating: Rs 8,000 deducted from the security deposit (Clause 11)
